title: C2 Milestone 13
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has superado el Milestone 13. Has dominado la dramática inversión negativa, navegado los laberintos del inglés legal, sorteado los peligros de la ética corporativa y cerrado el trato con maestría. Estás en la cima del mundo de los negocios.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes: 

1. Negative Inversion: 
- Never HAVE I seen... 
- Not only DID HE lie... 
- Under no circumstances SHOULD YOU... 
- Hardly HAD WE started when... 

2. Legal English: 
- Breach of contract & Liability. 
- The fine print & Loophole. 
- Litigation, lawsuit & settle out of court. 
- Legally binding & Force majeure.
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 13, Corporate Supremacy. This exam tests your mastery of our latest elite topics. First, Negative Inversion. Remember to invert the subject and auxiliary verb after negative phrases: Never HAVE I seen. Not only DID HE lie. Under no circumstances SHOULD YOU. Hardly HAD WE started when. Second, Legal English. Knowing terms like Breach of contract, legal Liability, reading the fine print, finding a loophole, and avoiding costly litigation by settling out of court.

parts.visual:
3. Corporate Ethics: 
- Compliance & ESG. 
- Bribery & Kickback (Soborno). 
- Embezzlement (Desfalco). 
- Money laundering & Nepotism. 
- Whistleblower & Conflict of interest. 

4. Closing the Deal: 
- Get down to brass tacks. 
- The bottom line. 
- Sweeten the deal & Meet halfway. 
- Drive a hard bargain. 
- Seal the deal & Deal-breaker.
parts.audio: Third, Corporate Ethics and Compliance. Navigating the dark side of business: Bribery, Embezzlement, Money laundering, Nepotism, and avoiding a Conflict of interest. Also knowing the role of a Whistleblower and ESG policies. Finally, Closing the Deal. The art of negotiation. Getting down to brass tacks, stating the bottom line, sweetening the deal, meeting halfway, driving a hard bargain, and ultimately, sealing the deal. Good luck on the exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu superioridad legal, ética y gramatical.

questions.question: Normal: I have never faced such a difficult negotiation. -> Inversion: Never ____ such a difficult negotiation.
If you don't deliver the software by Friday, our lawyers will sue you for ____ of contract.
The CFO was arrested for stealing $2 million from the company's pension fund. He is guilty of ____.
We've had enough coffee and small talk. Let's get down to ____ tacks and discuss the price. (Ir al grano).
Normal: He not only stole the design, but he also patented it. -> Inversion: Not only ____ the design, but he also patented it.
Before you sign the agreement, make sure you read the ____ print to check for hidden fees.
You can't be the auditor for this project because your husband owns the construction company. It's a ____ of interest.
I know you want $100,000 and we offered $80,000. Let's meet ____ at $90,000.
Normal: You must not talk to the press under any circumstances. -> Inversion: Under no circumstances ____ to the press.
The company's lawyers found a brilliant tax ____ that allowed them to legally avoid paying $50 million.
Paying the government inspector a secret fee to ignore safety violations is pure ____.
If you buy two containers today, I will ____ the deal by giving you a 10% discount on the third one.
Normal: We had hardly signed the contract when they declared bankruptcy. -> Inversion: Hardly ____ the contract when they declared bankruptcy.
We don't want the bad publicity of a public trial. We are going to ____ out of court.
The employee who exposed the company's illegal dumping of chemicals to the media is known as a ____.
I can negotiate the delivery date, but the final price is a deal-____. I will walk away if you change it.
Normal: The board rarely agrees so fast. -> Inversion: Rarely ____ so fast.
Once the document is signed by both CEOs, it becomes a legally ____ contract.
A massive criminal operation to hide the illegal origins of millions of dollars is called money ____.
We debated for hours, but the ____ line is that we don't have the cash to buy them.
questions.explanation: The bottom line (la conclusión / el problema real).

questions.question: Never ____ I seen... (Auxiliar)
Not only ____ she lie... (Auxiliar pasado)
____ of contract. (Incumplimiento con B)
A tax ____. (Vacío legal con L)
Jail for ____. (Malversación de fondos con E)
A ____ of interest. (Conflicto con C)
Down to ____ tacks. (Ir al grano con B)
____ the deal. (Sellar el trato con S)
The ____ line. (Lo importante con B)
Money ____. (Lavado de dinero con L)
